description: An event with author, time, content and context. Molecule shared by the feed and the compact version of ActivityTimeline.

howToUse: Use it for one event: who did what and when, such as "Ana approved the invoice, 2 h ago".
Fill `actor`, `title` and `timestamp`; add `description`, `badge` or `status` only when they change what the person reads.
Use `density="compact"` in side panels and small widgets.
alternatives: A list of events grouped by day: ActivityTimeline.

keyboard.action: Moves to the author link and to the action, when there are.
Opens the link or runs the action.
